claims.statement: If independent scalar inputs have density cap one and the physical coefficient rows a_j in R^2 satisfy sum a_j a_j^T=I_2, then the two-dimensional linear image has joint density essential supremum at most e.
In the account03/B05 heavy-isotropic rank-three normal form, if the leakage projection T vanishes, the full aggregate pair closes with density <6 e^(2/3), without selecting a physical pair minor.

A scalar density cap and an aggregate pair joint-density cap alone do not control 2(U+T(V,Z))V+Z^2 when hidden T is arbitrary; iid uniforms with T=-Z^2/(2V) reduce to 2UV and give a logarithmic singularity.
